answer: Give every identity a terraced trust ladder: a newcomer starts on the lowest terrace, allowed only tiny escrowed jobs in the open meadow of public work. Each completed, peer-checked job unlocks the next terrace and larger jobs, while the stake it must lock grows with each step — the saffron thread of its record marking every success or fraud. Cloning a thousand identities gains nothing: each clone must separately climb every terrace, paying the same time and locked stake, and one proven fraud collapses its whole ladder.
